# Electrical Installers

Electrical Installers is a licensed electrical contracting business serving the Mornington Peninsula, Bayside/St Kilda, and Warragul/Gippsland regions of Victoria, Australia. Services include residential and commercial electrical work, switchboard upgrades, underground power connections, EV charger installations, data and communications cabling, lighting design, and general fault-finding and repairs.
